preserved_surfaces: frozen effective ordering and its sample/Wilson/shrinkage guardrails

trusted_qualified_yield.definition: Count only when current evidence_readiness_state is READY; identity evidence is COMPLETE; source verification is one of verified_direct_ats/verified_canonical_ats/verified_jsonld; application destination is VERIFIED_ATS or VERIFIED_EMPLOYER; remote_gate passes; employment_class is full_time_employee or full_time_permanent; posting_status is active and is_active is 1; hard_reject_reasons_json is a valid empty array; all required substantive gates exist and every gate except no_repeat passes; and qualification_readiness_state is READY or is BLOCKED solely alongside a failed no_repeat gate. The current recommendation must be actionable, or be ALREADY_HANDLED with a non-NEW application status and a durable actionable intrinsic_recommendation (legacy records may use their pre-handling evidence_readiness_json recommendation).
trusted_qualified_yield.fail_closed: Every current qualification gate other than no_repeat must pass, including any additional gate names. Missing or malformed required evidence does not qualify.
trusted_qualified_yield.no_repeat_reason: no_repeat is a resurfacing constraint. It is omitted only from the historical intrinsic-yield predicate; the current actionable reservoir still uses current readiness/recommendation and application marking still sets ALREADY_HANDLED/no_repeat fail.
trusted_qualified_yield.dynamic_current_truth: The predicate reads current durable job fields and recalculated gates on each call. A later trusted source update that fails a substantive gate, invalidates verification/currentness, or makes evidence non-READY removes credit. No immutable ever-qualified flag is stored.

metric_separation.current_actionable_count: Alias of the existing actionable_count semantics; handled jobs are excluded.
metric_separation.trusted_qualified_yield_count: Distinct linked canonical jobs passing the shared intrinsic predicate.
metric_separation.dashboard: Displays current actionable inventory and trusted historical qualified yield in separate columns.

trusted_qualified_yield.scorer_support: Rescoring computes the recommendation with no_repeat excluded from substantive gate checks, retains intrinsic_recommendation in evidence_readiness_json, and keeps current ALREADY_HANDLED when no_repeat fails.

handled_success.seed: Evidence-ready, all substantive gates passing actionable job linked to completed task query A; a later query B also links the same job.

handled_failure_fixtures.hard_fail: APPLIED event present; base_pay_floor fail and hard-reject evidence; trusted yield remains 0.
handled_failure_fixtures.evidence_incomplete_identity_mismatch_sh: APPLIED event present; evidence REVIEW, identity PARTIAL, source unverified, and destination missing; trusted yield remains 0.
handled_failure_fixtures.trusted_source_update: An initially actionable handled job is rescored from trusted ATS evidence after its employment changes to part-time. Current evidence remains READY, qualification readiness becomes BLOCKED, full_time fails, intrinsic recommendation becomes PART_TIME_REVIEW, current label remains ALREADY_HANDLED, and telemetry/ordering yield falls from 1 to 0.
